integrity_note: Analytic all-order proof is supplemented by a standard-library checker performing 38 rational-exact finite tests for stated small graph orders. Computations are not represented as a proof for infinite orders.
scientific_limitations: Uniform labeled Cayley trees, iid exchangeable continuous vertex priorities, and their random-greedy independent set. The finite-order bivariate identity and residual blocked-edge expansion are proved; other tree ensembles, changing priority mechanisms, and general graphs are not covered. Independent mathematical validation and definitive historical priority are not established.
title: Degree-resolved random-greedy jamming and residual blocked edges in uniform labeled trees
